title: AI Techniques for Software Requirements Prioritization
shortDescription: Act as a release engineer for a Spotify-style product: interrogate an NLP model, design your own hybrid prioritization policy, implement it, stress-test it, and watch the selected requirements change the live application.
learningOutcomes: Apply supervised NLP classification to unstructured software requirements.
Integrate learned priority evidence with stakeholder value, strategic fit, effort, and accessibility impact.
Compare a vote-only baseline with an AI-assisted release plan under a fixed implementation budget.
Interpret model confidence and prioritization trade-offs rather than treating AI ranking as unquestioned authority.

courseAlignment.evidence: Students select and apply an AI-assisted prioritization method to a constrained software release-planning problem.
Students investigate how supervised NLP can support requirements prioritization and identify limitations of vote-only and AI-only reasoning.
Students interpret validation metrics, confidence values, ranking changes, and release-budget outcomes.

tasks.title: Diagnose the Baseline Release
tasks.description: Run the vote-only baseline, use the live product, and identify at least one release decision you believe is questionable before touching the AI.

tasks.title: Interrogate the NLP Model
tasks.description: Inspect probability distributions and evidence tokens for three backlog items, then use the live NLP playground to test your own requirement wording.

tasks.title: Design Your Release Policy
tasks.description: Choose and justify your own valid weights for AI evidence, business value, strategic fit, user demand, accessibility, and implementation effort.

tasks.title: Implement the Hybrid Priority Function
tasks.description: Translate your policy into Python so the score integrates learned NLP evidence with current software-engineering constraints.

tasks.title: Ship and Inspect the AI-Assisted Release
tasks.description: Run AI_ASSISTED mode, interact with the product features that were actually selected, and compare the release with the baseline.

tasks.title: Stress-Test the Decision
tasks.description: Perform a wording-sensitivity experiment and a policy-sensitivity experiment. Explain what changed and why.

tasks.title: Verify Engineering Requirements
tasks.description: Run the verification suite to test probability validity, model performance, policy constraints, scoring behavior, AI influence, ranking, and budget compliance.

tasks.title: Defend a Release Decision
tasks.description: Decide whether you would ship the baseline or AI-assisted plan. Support the decision with model evidence, product impact, sensitivity results, and limitations.
